---
title: "Sarasota Bay & Florida Bottlenose Dolphin Presence (2021–2026)"
subtitle: "An interactive scientific explorer built from 2,206 verified visual sightings (Jan 2021 – Nov 2026)"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(plotly)
library(crosstalk)

dolphins <- read_csv("data/florida_dolphins_2021_2026.csv") |>
  distinct(gbif_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    month_name = factor(month.name[month], levels = month.name),
    pod_label = if_else(is.na(group_size), "Not counted (presence verified)", paste0(group_size, " dolphin(s)")),
    obs_category = if_else(
      region == "Sarasota Bay Study Area",
      "Visual Sighting — Sarasota Bay Study Area",
      "Visual Sighting — Broader Florida Coast"
    ),
    popup_html = paste0(
      "<b>", obs_category, "</b><br>",
      "<b>Date:</b> ", event_date,
      if_else(!is.na(event_time) & event_time != "", paste0(" (", substr(event_time, 1, 5), ")"), ""), "<br>",
      "<b>Region:</b> ", region, "<br>",
      "<b>Pod Count:</b> ", pod_label, "<br>",
      "<b>Coordinates:</b> ", round(lat, 4), "°N, ", abs(round(lon, 4)), "°W<br>",
      "<b>Source:</b> ", source
    )
  )

# Compute live homepage statistics directly from the dataset
n_visual      <- nrow(dolphins)
n_sarasota    <- sum(dolphins$region == "Sarasota Bay Study Area")
n_days        <- n_distinct(dolphins$event_date)
n_years       <- n_distinct(dolphins$year)
top_month_row <- dolphins |> count(month_name, sort = TRUE) |> slice(1)
top_month_str <- paste0(top_month_row$month_name, " (", top_month_row$n, ")")

# Reference coordinates for major Sarasota Bay waterways
sarasota_labels <- tibble(
  name = c(
    "Sarasota Bay",
    "Anna Maria Sound",
    "Palma Sola Bay",
    "Big Sarasota Pass",
    "Roberts Bay",
    "Little Sarasota Bay",
    "Venice Inlet"
  ),
  lat = c(27.375, 27.505, 27.485, 27.275, 27.285, 27.205, 27.113),
  lon = c(-82.605, -82.700, -82.655, -82.568, -82.542, -82.502, -82.468)
)

shared_home <- SharedData$new(dolphins)

cat_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c(
    "Visual Sighting — Sarasota Bay Study Area" = "#e63946",
    "Visual Sighting — Broader Florida Coast"   = "#137c8b"
  ),
  levels = c(
    "Visual Sighting — Sarasota Bay Study Area",
    "Visual Sighting — Broader Florida Coast"
  )
)
```

This research platform investigates common bottlenose dolphin (*Tursiops truncatus*) sightings and seasonal presence from **January 2021 through December 2026**, pairing **2,206 verified GBIF visual sightings** across Florida's coastline (**207 inside the Sarasota Bay focal boundary** and **680 in adjacent Tampa Bay & Charlotte Harbor**) with 50+ years of demographic context from the Sarasota Dolphin Research Program ([Wells et al., 2025](https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/marine-science/articles/10.3389/fmars.2025.1531528/full)).

```{r}
htmltools::HTML(paste0(
  '<div class="stat-grid">',
  '<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">', scales::comma(n_visual), '</div><div class="stat-label">Verified Visual Sightings (2021–2026)</div></div>',
  '<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">', n_sarasota, '</div><div class="stat-label">Sightings Inside Sarasota Bay Box</div></div>',
  '<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">0 Public CSVs</div><div class="stat-label">Acoustic Detections (SBLN Restricted*)</div></div>',
  '<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">', scales::comma(n_days), '</div><div class="stat-label">Unique Observation Days</div></div>',
  '<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">', n_years, ' Years</div><div class="stat-label">2021–2026 (Dec 2026 Pending)</div></div>',
  '<div class="stat-card"><div class="stat-value">', top_month_str, '</div><div class="stat-label">Most Frequently Observed Month</div></div>',
  '</div>'
))
```

*\*Note on observation types: All 2,206 plotted points are verified visual sightings. Raw hydrophone whistle logs from the Sarasota Bay Listening Network (SBLN) require institutional permission and are documented in [Data & Methods](data-methods.qmd) rather than simulated.*

### Interactive Dolphin Presence Map (2,206 Observations, 2021–2026)

Toggle individual years or coastal zones below, or zoom directly into the **dashed red Sarasota Bay study box** (`26.85°N–27.56°N`, Anna Maria Sound to Venice/Lemon Bay) to inspect waterway labels and individual sightings.

::: {.filter-box}
```{r}
filter_checkbox(
  id = "home_year",
  label = "Select Survey Year(s) (2021–2026)",
  sharedData = shared_home,
  group = ~year,
  inline = TRUE
)

filter_select(
  id = "home_region",
  label = "Filter by Coastal Study Boundary",
  sharedData = shared_home,
  group = ~region
)
```
:::

```{r}
leaflet(shared_home, height = 540) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Voyager) |>
  setView(lng = -82.58, lat = 27.35, zoom = 9) |>
  # Dashed boundary box showing the Sarasota Bay focal study area
  addRectangles(
    lng1 = -82.85, lat1 = 26.85,
    lng2 = -82.30, lat2 = 27.56,
    fillColor = "transparent",
    color = "#e63946",
    weight = 2,
    dashArray = "6,6",
    group = "Sarasota Bay Boundary"
  ) |>
  # Waterway labels inside Sarasota Bay
  addLabelOnlyMarkers(
    data = sarasota_labels,
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    label = ~name,
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      noHide = TRUE,
      direction = "center",
      textOnly = TRUE,
      style = list(
        "color" = "#0b2545",
        "font-weight" = "bold",
        "font-size" = "11px",
        "text-shadow" = "1px 1px 2px #ffffff, -1px -1px 2px #ffffff"
      )
    ),
    group = "Sarasota Waterway Labels"
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = 5,
    color = ~cat_pal(obs_category),
    stroke = TRUE,
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.72,
    popup = ~popup_html,
    group = "Individual Sightings (2,206)"
  ) |>
  addLayersControl(
    overlayGroups = c("Individual Sightings (2,206)", "Sarasota Bay Boundary", "Sarasota Waterway Labels"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    pal = cat_pal,
    values = ~obs_category,
    title = "Observation Type & Zone",
    opacity = 0.9
  )
```

### 72-Month Dolphin Sightings Timeline (January 2021 – December 2026)

Every month from January 2021 through November 2026 contains verified observations; **December 2026** (future/not yet elapsed as of the November 13, 2026 data pull) is explicitly distinguished as unavailable rather than plotted as zero.

```{r}
# Build complete 72-month sequence Jan 2021 - Dec 2026
all_72 <- expand_grid(year = 2021:2026, month = 1:12) |>
  mutate(
    ym_date = make_date(year, month, 1),
    status = if_else(year == 2026 & month == 12, "Unavailable (Future Month)", "Observed")
  )

monthly_counts <- dolphins |>
  summarize(
    total_fl = n(),
    sarasota_bay = sum(region == "Sarasota Bay Study Area"),
    .by = c(year, month)
  )

timeline_72 <- all_72 |>
  left_join(monthly_counts, by = c("year", "month")) |>
  mutate(
    total_fl = if_else(status == "Observed", replace_na(total_fl, 0L), NA_integer_),
    sarasota_bay = if_else(status == "Observed", replace_na(sarasota_bay, 0L), NA_integer_),
    hover_fl = if_else(
      status == "Observed",
      paste0("<b>", format(ym_date, "%B %Y"), "</b><br>Florida Coast Sightings: ", total_fl, "<br>Sarasota Bay Sightings: ", sarasota_bay),
      "<b>December 2026</b><br>Data unavailable (month not yet elapsed at Nov 2026 download)"
    )
  )

plot_ly(timeline_72, x = ~ym_date) |>
  add_lines(
    y = ~total_fl,
    name = "All Florida Coast (2,206)",
    line = list(color = "#137c8b", width = 2.2),
    text = ~hover_fl,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  add_bars(
    y = ~sarasota_bay,
    name = "Sarasota Bay Study Area (207)",
    marker = list(color = "#e63946"),
    text = ~hover_fl,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  add_markers(
    data = filter(timeline_72, status != "Observed"),
    x = ~ym_date,
    y = 0,
    name = "Unavailable (Dec 2026)",
    marker = list(color = "#adb5bd", symbol = "x", size = 10),
    text = ~hover_fl,
    hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = "Monthly Verified Dolphin Sightings Across All 72 Months (Jan 2021 – Dec 2026)",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month (2021–2026)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Verified Visual Sightings"),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2),
    barmode = "overlay"
  )
```
